svg.title: See2Hear orchestration state transitions
svg.desc: A proposed search round with concurrent camera capture, speech cancellation, centering, a two-second haptic cue, five-frame voting, and three attempts to read a gate.
svg.text: Proposed state machine for one spoken airport-sign request
A. Listen and acquire a target
Camera capture runs throughout the foreground session. While listening, discard frames. Once a query is active, listen for cancel.
Keep the query ID and category.
Pick an eligible box; apply low vibration.
No eligible box or target lost.
Third centered observation of the same
candidate. Lock its track for this batch.
Center rule from the Python reference: box center inside the middle 24% on each axis, box overlap (IoU) ≥ 0.40, and successive observations ≤ 0.5 s apart.
B. Read five fresh frames while the two-second pulse runs
Start the two branches together for each attempt. Once one branch finishes, it waits for the other. Cancel or interruption preempts both.
Use this frame’s box for readSign
Same value in ≥3 of 5 wins a field.
On split votes, mark the field unknown.
Keep this verdict until the pulse finishes.
Both pulse and vote are complete.
Choose the speech or search action.
Track identity matters: a different screen entering the box cannot contribute a vote for the original candidate. A retry uses five new frames.
Compare raw gate digits before filtering on the requested ID. For a gate, take distance votes only from frames supporting the winning digit.
C. Select the announcement and wait for playback
Each row is a guarded transition after the pulse and vote. Keep the cancel listener active during every announcement.
Requested digit or readable generic gate.
Speak target and available distance. See Playback detail.
Same candidate identified on ≥3 of 5 frames.
Speak the sign and available details
No arrow majority → pass nil; speech omits the direction.
Another digit wins at least 3 of 5 votes.
NEW · Announce the observed wrong gate
Example: “This is Gate 6. I’ll keep looking for Gate 5.”
No digit wins at least 3 of 5 votes.
NEW · Ask the user to hold the phone still
Finish the prompt before sampling the next five frames.
Three total attempts, including the initial read.
Example: “Something went wrong. I couldn’t read the gate.”
These transitions apply across the active states, including the haptic timer, inference, silent waiting, and speech playback.
Invalidate the round ID. Cancel reads, speech,
listening tasks and timers. Apply haptics off.
Release active resources and discard late results.
Preserve camera capture only if still available.
Spoken cancel while resources are ready.
Stop capture; wait for foreground and access.
When resources return, restart capture and listen for a fresh query. A missing sign is a normal detector result; a thrown camera, model or speech error is a fault.
Proposed fault policy: abort on a one-round failure; enter Suspended if the required resource remains unavailable. Never replay a stale result or prompt.
If a washroom or restaurant lacks a stable candidate on 3 of 5 frames, return to Searching silently after the pulse. No distance majority → pass nil.
Vision supplies per-frame predictions; Orchestration owns tracking, batches, votes, timers and routing. Haptic already supports off, low and high.
Language detail · calls from A and C
Follow the row named at the call site. Each row shows the caller, the language work, and the event delivered back to orchestration.
Listen alongside searching, reading and speech playback.
Ignore the app’s own voice. Stop when the round ends.
Return to A when resources are ready.
Listening, Searching or Next attempt exit.
Speech and microphone faults route to D. Supporting cancel during playback requires coordinating the shared audio session and filtering app speech.
Retry assumption: the three-attempt limit applies to an unreadable gate episode. A readable wrong gate returns to search with that track suppressed while visible.
